description: The ETFs this server can answer for, with the date of the data and how many of the US-listed ETFs that is. Holdings come from the issuers' own daily files (tickers), from SEC filings (tickers_sec_nport, tickers_bond, tickers_multi_asset, tickers_derivative), from a trust's own filing (tickers_trust) or from a sponsor (tickers_sponsor). With query it returns only the funds whose ticker or name matches; include_tickers false leaves out the lists.

include_tickers.description: false leaves out the ticker lists.

query.description: A ticker or words from a fund's name, for example VOO or semiconductor. Case does not matter.

source.description: Only the funds read from the issuers' own files, only the stock ETFs from SEC filings, only the fixed income funds, only the multi-asset funds, only the derivative-based funds, only the trusts and pools, only the funds from their sponsors' files, or only the funds with only a prospectus file.

name: list_funds
title: List covered US ETFs
